svg.title: Fixed 2R model mismatch, saturation, timing and energy ledger
svg.desc: Six fixed runs, 5 ms zero-order-held motor torques, RK4 joint state and work integration. Panels C/E/F use mass and inertia 25 percent above the nominal controller. D compares the same joint path over .35 and 3 seconds with fixed limits (20,8) N m. Time rows are one deterministic trajectory, not independent robot trials. No contact model or physical robot.
